title: From the DMZ Into the Hermit Kingdom - Inside North Korea (Part 1/3)
summary: Vice founder Shane Smith travels to North Korea, speaking with refugees in South Korea before crossing the DMZ. It is part one of a three-part documentary with rare on-the-ground footage.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a rare, eye-opening look inside North Korea, though one notes such tours are staged.

quote.text: Vice has a three-part 1-hour-total documentary on North Korea with footage from the country.
